고려대학교 소프트웨어 학회 하나와영(One and Zero): One and Zero (OaZ), a software society at Korea University,
is the only software-focused society within the School of Electrical Engineering.
코딩과 소프트웨어에 대한 열정을 가진 학우들이 모여 함께 성장하고 도전하: We bring together students who are passionate about coding and software to learn, grow and take on challenges together. Korea University students from any department or year who are interested in software and eager to learn are welcome.
우리는 이진수의 0과 1을 우리만의 문장으로 풀어낸 이름처럼, 작은 차이: Our name gives the binary digits 0 and 1 a meaning of our own. We move forward together, believing that even small differences can create unlimited possibilities.
하나와영은 단순한 스터디를 넘어, 자유롭고 진취적인 배움의 장을 지향합니: OaZ aims to be an open, enterprising learning community that goes beyond study groups.
학기 중에는 다채로운 스터디와 세미나가, 방학 중에는 팀 프로젝트와 대회: During the semester, members take part in a variety of study groups and seminars. During breaks, they work on team projects and prepare for competitions. Members can plan and lead new study groups in their areas of interest.
We also support access to learning resources such as books and courses.
Explore records of study groups and seminars planned and run by members, organized by cohort.
